The McAllister family go on a holiday to Florida. Kevin McAllister gets separated from his family, and manages to get himself onto a plane to New York instead. There, he checks into the best hotel with his father's credit card and sets out to enjoy himself.

movie_title_en: Cantona: Flower of Evil + Live Q&A
synopsis:
On Monday, 7 December, join us for Cantona: Flower of Evil, followed by an exclusive interview broadcast live from Manchester with Eric Cantona.

The most gifted footballer of his generation was finished. Retired in disgrace at 25, he appeared destined for permanent exile from the sport he loved. Incapable of blind obedience, Eric Cantona was a libertine who bridled against conformity whenever he felt its grip tighten. The French branded him unmanageable. But the fire that burned in Eric became the spark to ignite a dynasty at Manchester United. 

At turns thoughtful and explosive, Cantona reveals how legendary manager Alex Ferguson channelled the brilliance of this most captivating and unpredictable of athletes. A tale of friendship and fatherhood, Cantona and Ferguson's testimonies reveal how a man misread as hostile and unknowable was finally understood, loved, and forgiven by the strictest disciplinarian in football.

A Norwegian woman (Renate Reinsve) and her devout Romanian husband (Sebastian Stan) relocate with their five children to a remote coastal town. As their teenagers grow closer to a neighbouring family, tensions begin to escalate when their tight-knit new community starts to question their rigid beliefs. Soon, the parents are forced to counter accusations that could tear their household apart – and battle a system that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

Captivatingly led by Academy Award nominees Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve, Cristian Mungiu’s Palme d’Or winner FJORD delivers a gripping study of a family under scrutiny.

Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
